description:
Make your feed a little calmer, on your terms.

Short Video Blocker is a Safari extension for Mac with three independent controls:
• Facebook videos: hide feed videos, including Reels and live streams.
• Facebook images: hide images in the feed while keeping post text visible.
• YouTube Shorts: hide short-video content while leaving regular YouTube videos available.

Turn each filter on or off separately. Keep the content you want and hide what distracts you.

GET STARTED
Open the app, enable the extension in Safari Settings → Extensions, and allow access to Facebook and YouTube. If those sites are already open, reload their tabs.

BUILT FOR SAFARI ON MAC
The extension works on the supported websites in Safari. It does not block content in the native Facebook or YouTube apps or in other browsers.

LOCAL FILTERING AND SETTINGS
Filtering runs locally, and your settings stay in extension storage on your Mac. Website access is needed to identify and hide content on the supported sites.

USAGE ANALYTICS YOU CONTROL
PostHog usage analytics are on by default. You can turn them off at any time from the extension menu → Settings. Only app launches and Safari extension starts are recorded, along with the app version, language and a random installation identifier. It does not send page content, page URLs, browsing history, names, email addresses or session recordings.

This is an independent app, not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Google or Meta.
promotionalText: Choose what you see: hide Facebook feed videos and images, and YouTube Shorts. Three independent controls, with settings stored on your Mac.
